brief.headline: Mass drone strike on Moscow; Russia squeezes Ukrainian ports
brief.lead: Channels led with a Ukrainian overnight barrage of 390+ drones on the Moscow region (81 reportedly downed) even as they celebrated an intensifying Geran-4 campaign against Odesa/Mykolaiv shipping and frontline gains around Konstantinovka. Overall tone was upbeat (54% positive), but strikes on Russian soil and defense-industry finances drew rare negativity.

developments.title: Ukraine launches 390+ drones at Moscow region
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed a large overnight raid of 390+ drones toward the Moscow region, with 81 reportedly intercepted near the capital (MoD-adjacent claims, unconfirmed). Two Majors and WarGonzo said a drone struck an apartment building in Chekhov near Moscow, framing it as civilian targeting.

developments.title: Geran-4 maritime campaign hits Mykolaiv, halts iron-ore output
developments.body: Channels touted Geran-4 strikes on cargo vessels in Mykolaiv port and Black Sea shipping, claiming attacks forced iron-ore producer Pivdennyi GOK to partly halt operations and drove diesel prices up. All claims are channel-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Claimed advances at Konstantinovka, Burluky and beyond
developments.body: Rybar, Poddubny and Kotsnews claimed Russian gains including clearing Konstantinovka, a reported 10km push on the Burluky direction (capturing Shevyakova and Artelnoye near the border), and taking Krasny Kut and Kommunarovka. Unconfirmed and likely selectively framed.

developments.title: Iran-Ukraine ship dispute; missile retaliation touted
developments.body: Channels claimed Kyiv negotiated with Iran to avert a ballistic strike after an attack on an Iranian civilian vessel, with Tehran demanding compensation. NgP raZVedka cited a Ukrainian expectation of an Iranian strike on July 28-29 — an unverified frame amplifying Ukraine-as-terror-state narrative.

developments.title: Car bombings in Odesa target Ukrainian officers
developments.body: Two Majors, Kotsnews and Starshe Eddy reported explosive devices detonated under vehicles of Ukrainian Navy logistics/security officers in Odesa. Presented as evidence of internal Ukrainian turmoil; attackers and attribution unclear.

developments.title: Rare criticism: defense-industry finances and Navy performance
developments.body: Rybar flagged Russian military-industrial firms burdened by credit and inadequate state advances despite large contracts, dissecting the 'super-profits' myth. Two Majors separately said the Navy is underperforming in the SMO and needs unmanned systems and stealth.

narrative_watch.title: Ukraine as global terrorist proxy
narrative_watch.body: Channels tied Ukraine to alleged terror cells in Iraq, Mali, India, Myanmar and Odesa car bombs, framing Kyiv as a mercenary/terror state renting fighters to the West.

narrative_watch.title: Anti-panic messaging on bank rumours
narrative_watch.body: Two Majors framed rumours of restricted bank access as a Ukrainian information operation to destabilize the Russian population — signalling domestic economic anxiety worth watching.

narrative_watch.title: Western drone-industry consolidation
narrative_watch.body: Rybar highlighted Ukraine exporting drone/air-defense expertise to Qatar and a European-Ukrainian interceptor-drone alliance, framing the West as dependent on Kyiv's technology.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant; port and maritime strike campaign framed as strangling Ukrainian logistics and industry.
Confident tone on multi-directional advances near Konstantinovka, Burluky and Dobropillia, with detailed tactical adaptation posts.
Sharp swing positive despite mass Moscow drone raid; channels emphasize interceptions while noting Kerch and Belgorod civilian casualties.
Negative on Leopard 2A8 assembly plant, Palantir AI modules and European air-defense projects; anxious about Western rearmament.
Mixed; sub launch and new drones cheered, but defense-industry credit strain dented an otherwise upbeat topic.
Uniformly negative: regional civil-defense failures, Navy underperformance and info-op panic warnings.

flag_texts.title: Strikes-on-Russia sentiment swings positive (+138)
flag_texts.body: Despite a 390+ drone raid on Moscow and casualties in Kerch and Belgorod, net sentiment jumped to +44 as channels emphasized 81 interceptions and reciprocal strikes on Kryvyi Rih and Odesa shipping rather than damage at home.

flag_texts.title: Russia-internal mood cools (-39)
flag_texts.body: The Ulyanovsk submarine launch and new Upyr-18 drone lifted mood, but Rybar's posts on defense-industry credit burdens and inadequate state advances pulled net sentiment down to +30.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation and Putin-criticism absent
flag_texts.body: No posts on mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin today; critical energy was directed at regional administrators, Navy command and the defense industry instead.
